name: B10-0131/2025 (Renew) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on repression in Nicaragua under Daniel Ortega and his wife Rosario Murillo. It condemns the jailing and harassment of opponents, human rights defenders and religious groups, and the recent constitutional reform that removed checks on presidential power. It asks for detainees to be freed, exiled people to get their rights and nationality back, and the constitutional reform to be reversed. It also asks the European Union to sanction Ortega and his inner circle and to watch how EU money is spent in Nicaragua.

- The European Union is asked to sanction Ortega and his inner circle, and to check that EU funds do not help his regime.
- Nicaragua's government is asked to free detainees, reverse its constitutional reform and respect human rights.
- The European Union is asked to use the democracy clause in its Central America agreement and to support exiles.
